GardaWorld Security Services is hiring a Surveillance Security Officer in Fort Worth, TX. You’ll monitor security systems, verify identities, and respond to threats while maintaining detailed incident reports.

The role offers a full-time schedule, competitive benefits, and opportunities for growth within GardaWorld. You’ll join a global security leader committed to safety and service.

jobs.title: Night Security Officer: Perimeter & CCTV (Midnight–8am)
jobs.description: A major amusement park in Arlington is seeking a Security Deep Night Officer to conduct perimeter checks and ensure guest safety from midnight to 8 am. Applicants must be at least 18 years old and possess a valid Level II License. The role requires flexibility to work at both Six Flags Over Texas and Hurricane Harbor Arlington. The ideal candidate will have a positive attitude, comply with grooming standards, and possess strong teamwork skills.
